item.title: Miami crash raises concerns about the jet's operator, and why it's flying for Amazon
item.description: The cargo plane crash in Miami is raising concerns about the safety culture at 21 Air, one of the carriers that fly for Amazon. Former pilots were sounding alarms even before Sunday's accident.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis capture a Red Sea island in threat to shipping
item.description: Iranian-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen have captured a strategic island in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. The move threatens Saudi oil exports through a key commercial lane. And Saudi Arabia said it shut down a major oil pipeline as a precaution after it came under attack.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: How shofars became the spiritual soundtrack of Rosh Hashanah
item.description: Rosh Hashanah, the Jewish New Year, begins at sunset Friday. For many Jews around the world, a highlight of the holiday will be hearing the shofar: an animal's horn blown like a trumpet.
